speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Our fiscal policies aim to ensure a dynamic economy and a strong social compact.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This provides assurance and opportunities and enables a higher quality of life for all Singaporeans.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We face a more dangerous and uncertain world.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The rules-based global order is weakening, with growing barriers to trade and cooperation.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: New technologies like artificial intelligence (AI) are reshaping industries, bringing disruption but also significant opportunities.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We must adapt quickly and harness these technologies to secure good jobs and higher incomes for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: With the faster pace of change, we must also strengthen social support and ensure that every citizen shares in our nation’s progress.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Fiscal discipline and strength are Singapore’s strategic advantages.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This is why we made earlier tax changes to strengthen our revenue base and structure.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Our framework enables GIC and Temasek to pursue long-term investment strategies that generate sustainable returns.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This provides a continued stream of revenue for the Budget, while maintaining our reserves as a strategic buffer against future shocks.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: In this uncertain world, we will continue to invest in our defence and security to safeguard our way of life.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will also deepen our cooperation with key partners, especially in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and broaden our relations with other countries.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: All of these efforts will require more resources.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: But they are essential to advancing national interests and protecting Singapore’s ability to chart our own course.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: MOF will play an active and constructive role in regional and international economic and financial fora to support a rules-based multilateral system that promotes shared prosperity and protects the global commons.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Growing a vibrant economy that provides good jobs for Singaporeans remains our foremost priority.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: By ensuring a stable and efficient tax, customs and regulatory environment, we will keep Singapore among the best places in the world to do business.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This will promote enterprise dynamism and growth and in turn contribute to job creation.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will make longer-term investments in our infrastructure to enhance our connectivity, support the green energy transition and build up our climate resilience.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We have begun setting aside funds for these critical needs and will continue to do so to prepare for the future.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will continue to strengthen our social compact and provide assurance to Singaporeans.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: In this term, we will build on these efforts.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will invest across all life stages, so that more opportunities are open to all Singaporeans regardless of starting points.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will keep public housing and healthcare affordable and accessible, enable our seniors to age well with peace of mind and strengthen support for caregiving.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will also enhance support for vulnerable groups, including persons with disabilities and those with special needs.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: By encouraging volunteering and charitable giving, we will nurture our culture of mutual care.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will continue to support initiatives in the arts, sports and community that strengthen the bonds which hold us together as one people.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will work with agencies to strengthen governance across finance, audit, procurement, grants management and risk management.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will continue to adopt best practices, strengthen central systems and processes, and build capabilities across the Public Service.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This will ensure that Government spending remains effective and delivers value for money.

speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: MOF will steward fiscal resources prudently and effectively to enable Singapore and Singaporeans to overcome challenges and seize new opportunities in a changing world.
